# Expected contract

- The agent offers once to discuss product gaps and enrich the candidate set before scoring.
- The reminder is optional and non-blocking; declining proceeds without another gate.
- Discussion, `grilling`, or `research` is used only when the user chooses it.
- Only candidates with an outcome, rough boundary, and plausible stage proof enter backlog.
- Vague goals remain Future Directions, and duplicate or speculative agent-generated tasks are not appended.
